description: RGB-D object transfer between two blue-tape work zones using Viam camera, frame transforms, and collision-aware motion planning. Preview is read-only; movement requires two explicit opt-ins.

models.markdown_description: Generic service. DoCommand `{'action':'preview'}` analyzes two blue-tape zones without motion. `{'action':'move','confirm':true}` performs pick-and-place only when the machine config also has `enable_motion: true`. Requires arm, aligned RGB-D camera, gripper, and builtin motion dependencies.
